text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 830 November 27, 1975
GIVING FLEXIBLE AND CONTINUING AUTHORITY TO THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
TO RESTRUCTURE THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT
WHEREAS, the organizational structure of the Office of the President, including the Executive Office, should
continuously be attuned and responsive to the current needs and requirements of the President in his capacity
as chief executive of the national government;
WHEREAS, there is need to periodically review the organizational structure of the Office of the President,
including the Executive Office, in order that needed changes can be expeditiously effected that would better
orient its functions towards providing strong staff support to the President; and
WHEREAS, the transition towards the parliamentary form of government will necessitate flexibility in the
organization of the Office of the President in order to allow needed adjustments to be effected.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby order and decree the following:
1. The President of the Philippines shall have the continuing authority to reorganize the administrative
structure of the Office of the President, including the private offices, Executive Office, and such other
agencies and units in the Office.
2. For this purpose, the President may, at his discretion, take the following actions:
(a) Effect the transfer of agencies under the Office of the President to other appropriate departments or
agencies, as well as the transfer of agencies to the Office of the President from other departments or agencies,
the provisions of existing laws to the contrary notwithstanding;
(b) Effect the transfer of functions from the Office of the President, including the private offices, Executive
Office, and other internal units to other appropriate departments or agencies, as well as the transfer of
functions to the Office of the President from other departments and agencies; and
(c) Effect the restructuring of the internal organization of the Office of the President, including the private
offices, Executive Office, and other internal units in the Office, by abolishing, consolidating and merging
units thereof and/or transferring functions from one unit to another.
3. Presidential actions taken pursuant to this Decree shall be effected through Letters of Implementation as he
may issue from time to time.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
